text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at the gym to pick up 
Mejiro McQueen—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, my whole body is aching... So this is 
the screaming muscles Ryan was talking 
about...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, there is no time to rest. Next, 
50 sets on that equipment over there—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Yes, I still have today's quota 
left to finish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The muscle training menu Ryan gave me. I 
must complete it until the very end, no 
matter what.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally. After all, this is the 'menu 
that surpasses all limits' that I 
specially requested."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—If I cannot overcome even the limits 
looming before me, I have no right to call 
myself a Mejiro Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Don't stop me! This is all for the sake of 
victory! One... two... three--!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
4... 5... Hehe, the night breeze feels so 
cool... The hot spring was the perfect 
temperature too, it was wonderful...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it is almost time for the baseball 
broadcast. Watching a different TV than 
usual... that is one of the joys of 
travel♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I've even secretly prepared sweets, so 
nothing will get in our way. Hehe, now 
then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Knock it out of the park, Yu-Ta-Ka! Knock 
it out of the paaaark, Yu-Ta-Ka~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Oh? That voice sounds so very familiar...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Relaxing here is nice and all, but... we 
can't afford to do that, can we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Gasp! T-Trainer-san! Where am I right 
now...?
choice_data_list: I was working out like crazy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so? I feel like I had a strange 
dream, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In any case... I am brimming with power. I 
feel as though I have surpassed my 
limits—!

Mejiro McQueen truly surpassed her limits 
and seemed to have obtained even greater 
power.
